fsim_pair — IMGMETRICS perceptual op

• Data kinds: rgbimage × rgbimage → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.fsim_pair(ref, dist, data_range: 'float' = 255.0, downsample: 'bool' = True) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import iqafsim; iqafsim.fsim_pair(ref, dist, data_range: 'float' = 255.0, downsample: 'bool' = True) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsimgmetrics.get("fsim_pair"))

Usage

FSIM and FSIMc in one call (phase congruency is computed only 1 time per image — evaluators and PoCs call this one).

Procedure (paper §III): (1) F×F averaging + decimation with F = max(1, round(min(H, W)/256)) (TID2013's 384×512 has F = 2 → 192×256), (2) phase congruency PC of Y and Scharr ([3 0 −3; 10 0 −10; 3 0 −3]/16) gradient magnitude G, (3) S_PC = (2 PC1 PC2 + T1)/(PC1² + PC2² + T1), S_G = (2 G1 G2 + T2)/(G1² + G2² + T2),

(4) FSIM = Σ S_G S_PC PC_m / Σ PC_m (PC_m = max(PC1, PC2)), (5) FSIMc additionally multiplies by the real part of the λ = 0.03 power of the chroma I / Q term S_I S_Q (T3 = T4 = 200).

Input is (H, W) or (H, W, 3) of the same shape (0–255; declare the scale with data_range). For (H, W), FSIMc = FSIM (there is no chroma term). TID2013 author values: FSIM.txt is from Y′ limited grey images, FSIMc.txt from colour images (the table in the module docstring) -- computing both from 1 colour image, the FSIM does not match FSIM.txt (max 0.0318). Returns {"fsim", "fsimc", "f"} (f = decimation factor). 1 for identical inputs. Raises ValueError: shapes differ, smaller than 2×2, phase congruency 0 at every pixel (flat image: FSIM is 0/0 and undefined).
